Scenario fixture: rgaa-img-describedby-target (RGAA 1.6.9)

Each target has a stable id of the form idt_case_NN. An image's aria-describedby associates its detailed description.

01 — FAIL: aria-describedby points to an id that does not exist
02 — PASS: aria-describedby points to the description

Les ventes montent de 5 % par trimestre.
